description: This file manages application lock settings, including enabling/disabling app lock, setting lock timeout, and managing credentials such as password and security key for authentication within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: registerCredential
methods.description: Registers a new credential, either password or security key, for app lock authentication.

methods.name: unlockAppLock
methods.description: Verifies credential and unlocks app lock.

methods.name: deactivateCredential
methods.description: Deactivates a given credential after verification.

methods.name: verifyCredential
methods.description: Verifies a credential, handling password or security key types accordingly.

methods.name: authenticateAppLock
methods.description: Authenticates the user for app lock, using the default active credential or account verification.
